games.title: Azul
games.intro: A system-level reference of Azul's mechanics (no story/lore content). Useful when designing abstract tile-laying games.

categories.name: Drafting & Supply
items: Factories (circle) hold 4 tiles drawn from a bag; players draft all tiles of one color from a factory, rest go to the center
Center pool accumulates unused tiles; first player to take from the center takes the starting-player token
Bag refill: tiles return to the bag at the end of each round

categories.name: Tile Placement
items: Player board: 5 pattern lines (1–5 cells); drafted tiles fill a line left-to-right
Overfill penalties — excess tiles are discarded and score negative points
Wall: 5x5 grid where completed lines are placed; no tile may repeat in a row or column
Floor line holds penalties; row bonus, column bonus, and set-completion bonuses

items.text: Broken tiles (discard overflow) reduce score at game end

categories.name: Scoring & Win Condition
items: Score as you fill the wall (adjacent-tile chain bonuses)
Endgame: first player to complete a full row ends the game; bonuses for columns and sets
